visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up of a chiffon cake in a circular tin, showing cracks on the golden-brown surface. A woman with glasses and a white sweater is superimposed at the bottom, arms crossed with a disappointed expression, looking at the cake. (2) The scene cuts to a hand reaching into a white oven to adjust a circular thermometer. The woman points toward the control panel of a Yamasaki brand oven, which features various cooking mode icons and a digital timer display. (3) A time-lapse shot shows a cake rising perfectly inside the oven while the woman explains her technique. A graphic editing effect triples her image momentarily to emphasize the 'staircase' baking method she is describing. (4) Quantitative temperature and time settings are displayed as a large text overlay over the image of the baking cake. The woman stands to the side of the text, pointing and gesturing towards the specific data points. (5) A close-up shot shows a hand gently pressing the side of a tall, fluffy yellow cake on a cooling rack to demonstrate its springy, soft texture. The woman is seen below smiling. (6) The woman takes a large bite of a cake slice, looks delighted with the flavor, and then playfully places the whole finished cake on her head like a crown while smiling.
